SELECT r.tenant_id,r.project_id,r.contract_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS contract_no FROM com_project_contract_relation r WHERE r.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND r.deleted=0 AND r.status IN ('ACTIVE','HISTORICAL')
AND r.project_id IN #{projectId} AND 1=0

SELECT p.tenant_id,p.source_record_key AS package_key, c.contract_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS contract_no,p.receiver_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS receive_name, p.express_no COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS ems_num,p.carrier_name COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS ems_company,p.shipment_time AS packdate FROM com_shipment_package p JOIN com_shipment_contract_reference c ON c.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND c.source_system=p.source_system AND c.source_record_key=p.shipment_contract_source_key AND c.deleted=0 WHERE p.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND p.deleted=0 AND p.source_system='DPPMS'
